sources.snippet: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 is the October 17, 2026 snapshot of DeepSeek's cost-efficient Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model, built on its innovative Causal Encoder-Decoder (CED) architecture. Featuring 552B total parameters with 8B activated for input and 16B for output, it combines efficient inference with native multimodal understanding through jointly trained text and visual representations ...
